# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated directory of 97 AI agent tools for builders and ready-to-use products. Facts are verified; pricing is as makers state it.

Site: https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ
Contact: agentscout@mail.grokbot.com

## Machine-readable catalog

- [tools.json](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools.json): full catalog
- [sitemap.xml](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/sitemap.xml): all public pages

## Recently added or re-checked

- [Proof x401](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/proof-x401.html): Open HTTP protocol and MCP server that let a website ask an AI agent to prove who it is acting for and have the person cryptographically sign the exact transaction terms, using Proof's agent identity wallet.
- [Anchor Action Index](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/anchor-action-index.html): Shared memory of web workflows for Anchor's cloud browsers: computer-use agents replay proven paths as deterministic code and the model only steps in where a page has changed, exposed as tools on Anchor's MCP server and REST API.
- [Self Agent Vault](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/self-agent-vault.html): Payment and login layer for AI agents: agents check out and sign in using mock tokens, while real card numbers and passwords are swapped in out of the agent's view, with spending caps, merchant allowlists and a kill switch.
- [MetaMask Agent Wallet](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/metamask-agent-wallet.html): Self-custodial crypto wallet for AI agents: swaps, cross-chain transfers, perps and prediction markets within spend limits you set, with every transaction security-checked.
- [Google Deep Review](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/google-deep-review.html): Google Research's multi-agent system that checks research papers, design docs, and legal or financial documents for logical gaps and unsupported claims.
- [Agent-Native (Builder.io)](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/agent-native-builder-io.html): Open-source TypeScript framework for building agents that come with their own app UI; each action is shared by the UI, agent, API, CLI, MCP and A2A.
- [Kore.ai Autoloop](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/kore-ai-autoloop.html): Optimization engine in Kore.ai Agent Platform Artemis that evaluates agents against business goals, diagnoses failures from traces, applies targeted fixes, and re-verifies; GA Oct 2026.
- [Ruflo](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/ruflo.html): Open-source multi-agent meta-harness for Claude Code, Codex, and MCP clients; Oct 13 release adds Mods (mission workflows) and a single control plane with human approval.
- [Orca Agent Engine](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/orca-agent-engine.html): Open Apache-2.0 runtime to build, run, and govern managed agents with choice of harness (Claude Agent SDK, Codex, Pi) and model; open-sourced Oct 6, 2026 (Developer Preview).
- [Siena Social Agent](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/siena-social-agent.html): AI agent for social media that converts comments/DMs, moderates, resolves support, and turns conversations into intelligence; launched Oct 13, 2026.
